#include <fstream>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

const bool DEBUG = true;
const string name = "I";

int main() {
    istream* in;
    ostream* out;
    ifstream fin;
    ofstream fout;

    if (DEBUG) {
        in = &cin;
        out = &cout;
    } else {
        fin.open(name + ".in");
        fout.open(name + ".out");
        in = &fin;
        out = &fout;
    }

    float N, P;
    *in >> N >> P;

    for (int i = 0; i <= N; ++i) {
        double val = i * (i - 1) * (i - 2) / 6.0
                   + i * (i - 1) * (N - i) / 2.0
                   + i * (N - i) * (N - i - 1) / 4.0;
        val = val / (N * (N - 1) * (N - 2) / 6.0);

        if (val >= P) {
            *out << i << endl;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!DEBUG) {
        fin.close();
        fout.close();
    }

    return 0;
}
